events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Remember the day music TV changed forever? On this day in 1981, MTV launched, kicking off with The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. What was the first music video that truly blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis released 'Definitely Maybe'
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-six years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' – the album that kicked off a whole new era. What's your favourite track from this absolute classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair began, bringing together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy live on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1970, we lost a true guitar icon, Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking sound continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and timeless tracks – what's your go-to from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine' (single)
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Release Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A song that still resonates today.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? It changed everything for music lovers! What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Global Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! On this day in 1962, 'Dr. No' premiered, kicking off the iconic 007 film franchise. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem track from it?
